descriptions.text: Based on Monero’s privacy-centric DeFi protocol Haven Protocol (XHV), it released analysis reports and measures for three serious attacks related to it in late June. The chain rollback plan will be initiated and a hard fork will be implemented. Fix the known vulnerabilities in protocol minting. Regarding specific attacks, on June 24, 203,000 xUSD and 13.5 xBTC were minted in two attacks; on June 27, an unknown amount of XHV was minted due to a vulnerability in the conversion verification of xAsset; June 29 , The attacker exploited a vulnerability that allowed the minting of 9 million xUSD.

Haven Protocol suffered a series of exploits in June 2021, allowing attackers to illegitimately mint assets and bypass conversion checks. The community responded with a chain rollback to block 886575, reversing most of the inflation and pausing asset conversion until new validation logic was audited and deployed. Broken asset validation and conversion checks enabled unauthorized minting. Vulnerabilities included miner reward validation errors, conversion accounting bugs, and failures to reject inconsistent transaction data.
